title: El Cerro Rico de Potosí y la plata que cambió el mundo
goal: Investigate the history of the Cerro Rico of Potosí, colonial silver mining, the mita labor levy, and El Tío.
grammar: historia minera virreinal del Cerro Rico, economía global de la plata y culto a El Tío

items: Analyze the historical impact of the Potosí silver bonanza on global trade.
Examine the human reality of the colonial mita labor system in the mine shafts.
Deploy mining history, colonial coinage, and metallurgy vocabulary (socavón, mita, plata, metalúrgico).
